name: Theofanis Eleftheriades
bio: Theofanis Eleftheriades graduated from Cardiff University with a Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering in 2021 and a Master's in Software Engineering in 2022. He has previously worked as a System Administrator for a utility company and is currently employed as a Software Engineer I at KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence.
shortBio: Software engineer developing research platforms and cyber range infrastructure at KIOS CoE.
